design_findings.conclusion: Current source guards authenticate reviewer/read subject and current sealed basis before exact hash, location and origin-kind gates. Tests must demonstrate prior valid shape/current state/basis and exact target failure; subject-invalid and origin-invalid controls are distinct. Own current-body hash mutation is an explicitly INJECTED corruption witness, not a public exploit.

Current SQL triggers protect UPDATE bytes/content_hash/project when OLD.sealed=1 and DELETE sealed rows. Proposed own-DB sealed toggle permits controlled corruption without disabling triggers. Record the complete transition and unchanged sqlite_schema, artifact metadata/history; require local=false and fresh non-replayed search reaching exact CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH branch.

Three source kinds each get explicit valid positive, HTTPS/userinfo and enabled-kind/origin negative controls. Full request/schema and original sealed Artifact must pass earlier gates. Product OBSERVED/LIVE fields remain fixture data, never LIVE_SERVICE evidence; no Fetch/network/credential lookup.

Missing identity, changed actual root identity, lexical refusal-before-OpenRoot, final/intermediate absence and sentinel fallback match actual distinct branches. Sentinel fallback is a unit classifier witness only. Actual symlink versus irregular reparse mode must be observed separately; cannot substitute or count unavailable/skip as PASS.

Actual search ref/hash/line and ContextBundle/materialized bytes can prove source-input linkage. Stale source check must precede destination creation. No answer/candidate/model producer is exercised or accepted.

Principal and grant tests require otherwise equal actual operands. Project comparison discloses empty-manifest limitation; content invalidation is a multi-operand causal chain. fts5-v1 constant cannot be independently varied with this scope; index-singleton claim stays HOLD.

implementation_conditions: Preserve all pre-existing function bodies/comments/check IDs/expected errors/SQL trigger setup and original failure disclosures byte-for-byte. Restrict gofmt effects to new additions/imports; do not normalize protected bodies.

A negative passes only after paired positive and all earlier-guard prerequisites are proven. Record precise status/code/message and absence of unintended writes; wrong earlier refusal fails qualification.
No production mock hook, trigger removal/DDL relaxation, shared-fixture alteration, registry/schema/SDK/backend switch, old DB access or source mutation outside exact4.
All injected body/upload/auth metadata changes remain owned fresh fixture DB state with disclosed before/after row differences. Never describe the injection as a public authorization bypass.

Actual OS link construction, Go compile/tests, SQL/API/HTTP, native tools and capability probes remain NOT_AUTHORIZED in this phase. Later finite controller must pin numerical deadlines/caps, owned child/tool hashes, full compiler/OS/fixture closure and exact selectors before Root grants execution.

At implementation handoff preserve all four preimage snapshots and independently compare protected spans plus exact import/addition diffs. Whole candidate/test roster needs non-author review before runtime grant.
Future closed snapshots must be proven checkpointed/closed; any readonly copy inspection uses immutable read and before/after sidecar checks. Never delete sidecars merely to make evidence pass.
